events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: Using only Tab, Enter and typing into the focused field, I booked Atlas and reached a visible confirmation in evidence #48: 'You've got a room', Confirmed, Meeting 'Quarterly planning', Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, People 12, Projector Included, Reservation total $280 all charges included.

Interpretação simulada: Keyboard-only booking succeeded in this session: visible focus was trackable, required controls were reachable by Tab and activated by Enter, the name field accepted typing once focused, and the confirmation verifies the requested meeting details within budget.

Limites: This verifies one keyboard-only Atlas booking in this browser session. Space-key activation, Shift+Tab recovery, other rooms and persistence beyond the session (the footer says reservations are saved only in this browser session) were not tested.

Capturas indicadas: #16, #30, #34, #46, #48. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Keyboard focus and Enter activation worked through the whole booking flow
findings.observation: Tab moved focus in a sensible order with a visible blue outline: Gather logo, Our spaces, My reservations, Find your space, Change, then Choose Atlas; on later pages the same restart-at-header order reached Choose another room, the Meeting name input, Review booking, Edit meeting name and Confirm reservation. Enter activated Choose Atlas, Review booking and Confirm reservation.
findings.expected: Required booking controls should receive keyboard focus and activate with standard keys.
findings.expectedSource: Saved charter: keyboard-only access requirement and stated expectation of visible focus and keyboard-operable controls.
findings.personaComment: I could follow the blue focus outline at every step and use Enter where I expected to.
findings.interpretation: The full booking path was completable independently by keyboard in this run, with no mouse, touch or coordinate clicks used.
findings.uncertainty: Only the Atlas path and Enter activation were tested; Space activation and other rooms were not exercised.

findings.title: Confirmed reservation matches purpose, capacity, projector and budget
findings.observation: Atlas was shown as 12 seats, 1 hr 10:00-11:00 with projector and $280 all-in total. After typing 'Quarterly planning' while the name input was focused, review restated projector and seating for 12 at $280, and the confirmation showed Confirmed, Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, Projector Included and $280 all charges included.
findings.expected: The visible confirmation should match Quarterly planning, 12 people, projector and an all-in total within $350.
findings.expectedSource: Persona mission and saved charter success criteria.
findings.personaComment: The confirmation repeats every detail I needed to check, so I can trust this booking is the right one.
findings.interpretation: The selected room and final confirmation satisfy the stated meeting and budget constraints.
findings.uncertainty: The footer states reservations are saved only in this browser session; persistence beyond the session was not tested.

finding.interpretation: Keyboard-only booking succeeded in this session: visible focus was trackable, required controls were reachable by Tab and activated by Enter, the name field accepted typing once focused, and the confirmation verifies the requested meeting details within budget.

persona.name: Casey · Keyboard access
persona.description: A fictional Home v3 persona who needs to complete the booking using only the keyboard.
persona.label: Casey · Keyboard access
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting and rely on keyboard navigation. You need to reach and operate each required control without using a mouse or touch.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know the meeting requirements, but have no walkthrough, knowledge of its rooms or prices, or prior reservation.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know the meeting requirements, but have no walkthrough, knowledge of its rooms or prices, or prior reservation.
persona.constraints: You need seats for all 12 people and a projector. The complete cost, including any fees and equipment, must not exceed $350. Use only the fictional meeting details. Use keyboard navigation and typing only. Do not click coordinates or controls, use touch, select an option through a pointer shortcut, or bypass the visible interface. Type only after establishing keyboard focus.
persona.skills: Experienced with Tab navigation, visible focus, Enter and Space activation, arrow keys where supported, and typing into the focused form field.
persona.decision: Follow the visible focus through the booking flow and use keyboard activation for controls. If a required control appears unreachable, attempt reasonable keyboard navigation and report the exact observed barrier without assuming a defect in advance.
persona.resources: A desktop browser and keyboard, with fictional meeting details. No mouse or touch input, real account, or payment information.
persona.expectations: Visible keyboard focus, a sensible focus order, keyboard-operable room selection and forms, and a readable reservation confirmation.
persona.priorities: Complete the reservation independently using the keyboard and identify any observed control that prevents that goal.
persona.successCriteria: Verify a visible confirmed reservation with the requested meeting purpose, 12 attendees, a projector, and an all-in total within $350. Report any missing or uncertain detail accurately. Reach this outcome through keyboard interaction alone.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, an unsafe action, or the session limits. Do not book beyond your budget or claim success without visible evidence.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Landing page shows Gather header, 'Find your space' button, meeting summary Tomorrow 10:00-11:00 for 12 people with projector, and Atlas $280 and Willow $245 room cards.
experience.reaction: Starting with Tab to find the first focusable control.

experience.observation: After one Tab, the Gather logo at top left has a clear blue focus outline; header links are to the right.
experience.reaction: Good, I can see focus on the logo. Continuing forward through the header.

feedback.summary: Visible blue outline on the Gather logo after first Tab makes focus location clear
feedback.why: The outline in evidence #6 shows I can track keyboard focus from the start, which I need to navigate without a mouse.

experience.observation: Focus outline is now on 'Our spaces' in the top navigation.
experience.reaction: Focus moved to 'Our spaces' in the header. Continuing Tab toward the booking controls.

experience.observation: Focus outline is on the 'My reservations' pill button in the header.
experience.reaction: Focus is on 'My reservations' now. Moving on to the main content.

experience.observation: Focus outline is on the blue 'Find your space' button below the headline.
experience.reaction: I've reached 'Find your space'. Continuing Tab to see what comes next in order.

experience.observation: Focus outline is on 'Change' at the right end of the 'YOUR MEETING' summary bar.
experience.reaction: Focus is on 'Change'. Next I expect the room options.

experience.observation: Page scrolled to the room cards; 'Choose Atlas' has a blue focus outline. Atlas shows 12 seats, $280 all-in, 1 hr with projector.
experience.reaction: Atlas fits — 12 seats, projector, $280 total. I'll activate 'Choose Atlas' with Enter.

feedback.summary: Tab reaches 'Choose Atlas' with visible focus and scrolls the room cards into view
feedback.why: Evidence #16 shows Atlas has 12 seats, 1 hr 10:00-11:00 with projector, and $280 all-in total within my $350 budget, and its Choose button is keyboard-focused.

experience.observation: Details page shows 'Meeting name' input with placeholder 'e.g. Quarterly planning', a 'Review booking' button, and a summary confirming Atlas, 12 people, projector included, $280 total.
experience.reaction: I'm on the meeting details step. I'll Tab to find the meeting name field.

experience.observation: After first Tab on the details page, focus is again on the Gather logo.
experience.reaction: Focus restarted on the logo on this new page. Continuing Tab in order.

experience.observation: Focus outline is on 'Our spaces' in the header on the details page.
experience.reaction: Focus on 'Our spaces' — continuing forward.

experience.observation: Focus is on 'My reservations' in the header.
experience.reaction: Past the header links, heading toward the form.

experience.observation: Focus outline is on the 'Choose another room' link above the progress steps.
experience.reaction: Focus is on 'Choose another room'. One more Tab should reach the name field.

experience.observation: The 'Meeting name' input has a blue focus outline and placeholder 'e.g. Quarterly planning'.
experience.reaction: The name field is focused, so I'll type the meeting purpose now.

feedback.summary: Meeting name input receives clear keyboard focus before typing
feedback.why: Evidence #28 shows the focused input with a blue outline, so I can type into the currently focused field as required without guessing focus location.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field now contains 'Quarterly planning' and remains focused; 'Review booking' button is below right.
experience.reaction: Name entered correctly. Moving Tab to the review step.

experience.observation: 'Review booking' button has a blue focus outline; the entered name and $280 summary remain visible.
experience.reaction: Review is focused, so I'll activate it with Enter.

experience.observation: Review page shows meeting name 'Quarterly planning', text confirming projector and seating for 12, Atlas summary at $280 total, and a 'Confirm reservation' button.
experience.reaction: The review matches my needs. I'll Tab toward 'Confirm reservation'.

feedback.summary: Review page restates Quarterly planning, projector and seating for 12 with $280 total before confirming
feedback.why: Evidence #34 lets me verify the purpose, 12-person seating, projector inclusion and budget before committing, matching my success checks.

experience.observation: Focus is on the Gather logo at the top of the review page.
experience.reaction: Focus restarted at the logo on the review page. Continuing forward.

experience.observation: Focus is on 'Our spaces' in the header on the review page.
experience.reaction: On 'Our spaces' now — next stops should bring me to Confirm.

experience.observation: Focus is on 'My reservations' in the header.
experience.reaction: Past 'My reservations', moving into the review actions.

experience.observation: Focus is on 'Choose another room' above the review heading.
experience.reaction: On the back link now. Continuing toward the confirm button.

experience.observation: Focus outline is on the 'Edit meeting name' button on the review card.
experience.reaction: Focus is on 'Edit meeting name'. One more Tab should reach Confirm.

experience.observation: 'Confirm reservation' button has a blue focus outline; review shows Quarterly planning, 12 people, projector included, $280 total.
experience.reaction: Confirm is focused and the details look right, so I'll press Enter.

feedback.summary: 'Confirm reservation' is reachable by Tab with a visible focus outline on the review page
feedback.why: Evidence #46 shows the Confirm button focused after tabbing through Edit meeting name, so the final required control is keyboard-operable.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room using only the keyboard
charterSnapshot.description: AI Persona keyboard-access demo; environment contains a deliberately seeded barrier, which is not disclosed in the exploration instructions.
charterSnapshot.mission: Complete the booking from the persona’s point of view using only keyboard navigation and text entry. Verify the final reservation. Observe the product rather than assuming its accessibility.
charterSnapshot.scope: Landing page through room selection, meeting details, review and confirmation. No mouse, touch, coordinate clicks, control clicks or programmatic focus shortcuts.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible confirmation matches the meeting purpose Quarterly planning, 12 people, projector and the persona’s budget, reached using keyboard interaction alone.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: Stop on verified success or a specific observed keyboard barrier. If a required visible control cannot be reached after two complete Tab cycles, check reverse Tab once, then finish with an evidence-backed blocked report; do not repeat unchanged cycles indefinitely. Stop on execution limits without treating the limit or an agent error as a product defect.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a fresh browser session. No prior reservation, product walkthrough, or knowledge of defects.
charterSnapshot.goals: Reserve a suitable room and verify the visible confirmation using keyboard interaction only.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s declared keyboard-only access requirement and meeting requirements, the product-visible prices and recorded confirmation. Required booking controls should receive keyboard focus and activate with standard keys. Preserve pricing and pointer booking paths.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Keyboard keypresses and typing into the currently focused field only. Do not use pointer clicks, scrolling tools, select-option shortcuts, or navigational bypasses. Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and arrow keys may be used as appropriate.
